outcome: Admissions to the prenatal observation ward
Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 166 pregnant women diagnosed with gestational hypertensive disorders (GHD) at a 2nd level prenatal center
finding: Remote monitoring for pregnant women with GHD was associated with fewer prenatal visits, fewer admissions to the prenatal observation ward, less labor induction, more spontaneous labors, and fewer neonatal hospitalizations compared to conventional care.
mod_finding: Remote monitoring was associated with less labor induction and more spontaneous labors in pregnant women with GHD.
